entries_source.title: Fréquentation en gares
entries_source.role: Passengers per station per year (2025): a weight for how many people use a station, not a count of wheelchair users; UIC + postcode locate NeTEx stop places in a département since the 2026-11-24 NeTEx carries no INSEE code

overview.method: Ordered station pairs joined by a step-free journey (board and alight only at boardable, usable platforms; changes inside a station). Exact reachability over the GTFS network stored in Relate.

rank.method: Each candidate is evaluated alone against the same view; gain = additional confirmed ordered station pairs. Order: gain, then daily validations at the station (busiest first), name, id.
